The plate spans about 355 px across, so I treated it as a roughly 20-26 cm plate. Taking about 24 cm, that gives roughly 0.068 cm per px.

The sausage is about 140 px long, or about 9.5 cm, and about 60 px wide, or about 4 cm. That makes it a fairly thick sausage, probably 3.5 cm across. Modeling it as a cylinder with a 3.5 cm diameter and 9 cm length gives π × 1.75² × 9 ≈ 87 cm³. At a density of about 1 g/cm³, that is roughly 85 g. Allowing for the rounded ends, I settled on about 80 g.
